trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Found the healthy version**: Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: First rollback attempt failed partway (halted after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1 with ~18% error rate. Retried the rollback, which completed successfully — **all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0**.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0002** is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. (First attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid a duplicate.)
